note: Fails if day-adjacent states with identical facts stop merging into one state (2018 and 2019 state the same list, so one state 2018-2019), if a state merges with a neighbour whose value set differs (2020 adds a code and stays its own state), if the merged state stops keeping its earliest segment's ID (the ID minted from the 2018 coordinates, scb/example/lan/annual/2018-01-01, answers its list), or if the absorbed 2019 segment's ID still resolves instead of not_found. The IDs are the builder's state mint of the fixture coordinates (#1296 2d).
